= self.dual[3];\n\n [\n 2.0 * (-dw * rx + dx * rw - dy * rz + dz * ry),\n 2.0 * (-dw * ry + dx * rz + dy * rw - dz * rx),\n 2.0 * (-dw * rz - dx * ry + dy * rx + dz * rw),\n ]\n }", "bundle": radius.\n radius: f64,\n },\n /// General Non-Uniform Rational B-Spline (NURBS) curve.\n Nurbs {\n /// Degree of basis functions (p).\n degree: usize,\n /// Control points [x, y, z, weight].\n "description": "Evaluate 3D point on curve at parameter `t`.", "resource": "crates/oxide-geo/src/curve.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-geo", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn evaluate(&self, t: f64) -> [f64; 3] {\n match self {\n Self::Line { origin, direction } => [\n origin[0] + direction[0] * t,\n origin[1] + direction[1] * t,\n origin[2] + direction[2] * t,\n ],\n Self::Circle {\n center,\n normal,\n radius,\n } => {\n let n = glam::DVec3::from_slice(normal).normalize_or_zero();\n let ref_axis = if n.x.abs() < 0.9 {\n glam::DVec3::X\n } else {\n glam::DVec3::Y\n };\n let u = n.cross(ref_axis).normalize();\n let v = n.cross(u);\n\n let angle = t * std::f64::consts::TAU;\n let c = glam::DVec3::from_slice(center);\n let p = c + u * (angle.cos() * radius) + v * (angle.sin() * radius);\n [p.x, p.y, p.z]\n }\n Self::Nurbs {\n degree,\n control_points,\n knots,\n } => "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn evaluate(&self, t: f64) -> [f64; 3] {\n match self {\n Self::Line { origin, direction } => [\n origin[0] + direction[0] * t,\n origin[1] + direction[1] * t,\n origin[2] + direction[2] * t,\n ],\n Self::Circle {\n center,\n normal,\n radius,\n } => {\n let n = glam::DVec3::from_slice(normal).normalize_or_zero();\n let ref_axis = if n.x.abs() < 0.9 {\n glam::DVec3::X\n } else {\n glam::DVec3::Y\n };\n let u = n.cross(ref_axis).normalize();\n let v = n.cross(u);\n\n let angle = t * std::f64::consts::TAU;\n let c = glam::DVec3::from_slice(center);\n let p = c + u * (angle.cos() * radius) + v * (angle.sin() * radius);\n [p.x, p.y, p.z]\n }\n Self::Nurbs {\n degree,\n control_points,\n knots,\n } => evaluate_nurbs_curve(*degree, control_points, knots, t),\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/curve/evaluate_nurbs_curve", "title": "evaluate_nurbs_curve", "type": "Function", "description": "De Boor algorithm for evaluating rational B-Spline / NURBS curve at parameter `t`.", "resource": "crates/oxide-geo/src/curve.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-geo", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": "fn evaluate_nurbs_curve(\n degree: usize,\n control_points: &[[f64; 4]],\n knots: &[f64],\n t: f64,\n) -> [f64; 3] {\n if control_points.is_empty() || knots.is_empty() {\n return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0];\n }\n let n = control_points.len();\n let p = degree;\n\n // Clamp t to knot bounds\n let t_min = knots[p];\n let t_max = knots[n];\n let clamped_t = t.clamp(t_min, t_max);\n\n // Find knot span k\n let mut k = p;\n for i in p..n {\n if clamped_t >= knots[i] && clamped_t < knots[i + 1] {\n k = i;\n break;\n }\n if (clamped_t - t_max).abs() < 1e-9 {\n k = n - 1;\n break;\n }\n }\n\n // Initialize working points in homogeneous coordinates\n let mut d: Vec<[f64; 4]> = Vec::with_capacity(p + 1);\n for j in 0..=p {\n let idx = k.saturating_sub(p) + j;\n let pt = control_points\n .get(idx)\n .copied()\n .unwrap_or([0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0]);\n let w = pt[3];\n d.push([pt[0] * w, pt[1] * w, pt[2] * w, w]);\n }\n\n // Triangular de Boor reduction\n for r in 1..=p {\n for j in (r..=p).rev() {\n let idx = k.saturating_sub(p) + j;\n let denom = knots.get(idx + p + 1 - r).copied().unwrap_or(1.0)\n - knots.get(idx).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);\n let alpha = if denom.abs() > 1e-12 {\n (clamped_t - knots[idx]) / denom\n } else {\n 0.0\n };\n\n let prev = d[j - 1];\n let curr = d[j];\n d[j] = [\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[0] + alpha * curr[0],\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[1] + alpha * curr[1],\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[2] + alpha * curr[2],\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[3] + alpha * curr[3],\n ];\n }\n }\n\n let result = d[p];\n let w = if result[3].abs() > 1e-12 {\n result[3]\n } else {\n 1.0\n };\n [result[0] / w, result[1] / w, result[2] / w]\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/curve/tangent", "title": "tangent", "type": "Function", "description": "Evaluate tangent derivative vector `C'(t)` on curve at parameter `t`.", "resource": "crates/oxide-geo/src/curve.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-geo", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn tangent(&self, t: f64) -> [f64; 3] {\n let eps = 1e-5;\n let p1 = self.evaluate(t - eps);\n let p2 = self.evaluate(t + eps);\n let dx = (p2[0] - p1[0]) / (2.0 * eps);\n let dy = (p2[1] - p1[1]) / (2.0 * eps);\n let dz = (p2[2] - p1[2]) / (2.0 * eps);\n let len = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();\n if len > 1e-12 {\n [dx / len, dy / len, dz / len]\n } else {\n [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/drafting_2d", "title": "drafting_2d", "type": self.active_osnaps.contains(&OsnapMode::Midpoint) {\n let mid = Point2D::new((start.x + end.x) * 0.5, (start.y + end.y) * 0.5);\n let d_mid = cursor.distance_to(&mid);\n if d_mid <= tolerance\n && best.as_ref().is_none_or(|b| d_mid < b.distance_to_cursor)\n {\n best = Some(OsnapCandidate {\n point: mid,\n mode: OsnapMode::Midpoint,\n distance_to_cursor: d_mid,\n });\n }\n }\n }\n DraftingEntity2D::Circle { center, radius } => {\n if self.active_osnaps.contains(&OsnapMode::Center) {\n let d_center = cursor.distance_to(center);\n if d_center <= tolerance\n && best\n .as_ref()\n .is_none_or(|b| d_center < b.distance_to_cursor)\n {\n best = Some(OsnapCandidate {\n point: *center,\n mode: OsnapMode::Center,\n distance_to_cursor: d_center,\n });\n }\n }\n if self.active_osnaps.contains(&OsnapMode::Quadrant) {\n let quads = [\n Point2D::new(center.x + radius, center.y),\n Point2D::new(center.x - radius, center.y),\n Point2D::new(center.x, center.y + radius),\n Point2D::new(center.x, center.y - radius),\n ];\n for q in quads {\n let d = cursor.distance_to(&q);\n if d <= tolerance\n && best.as_ref().is_none_or(|b| d < b.distance_to_cursor)\n {\n best = Some(OsnapCandidate {\n point: q,\n mode: OsnapMode::Quadrant,\n distance_to_cursor: d,\n });\n }\n }\n }\n }\n _ => {}\n }\n }\n\n best\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": Some(h0);\n }\n if let Some(edge) = self.half_edges.get_mut(h2) {\n edge.next = Some(h0);\n edge.prev = Some(h1);\n }\n\n // Set vertex outgoing edges if unset\n if let Some(v) = self.vertices.get_mut(v0) {\n if v.half_edge.is_none() {\n v.half_edge = Some(h0);\n }\n }\n if let Some(v) = self.vertices.get_mut(v1) {\n if v.half_edge.is_none() {\n v.half_edge = Some(h1);\n }\n }\n if let Some(v) = self.vertices.get_mut(v2) {\n if v.half_edge.is_none() {\n v.half_edge = Some(h2);\n }\n }\n\n let face_key = self.faces.insert(HeFace { half_edge: h0 });\n\n if let Some(edge) = "crates/oxide-geo/src/half_edge.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-geo", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn laplacian_smooth(&mut self, factor: f64) {\n let mut new_positions: Vec<(HeVertexKey, [f64; 3])> = Vec::with_capacity(self.vertices.len());\n\n for (v_key, v) in &self.vertices {\n let mut neighbor_sum = DVec3::ZERO;\n let mut count = 0.0;\n\n // Iterate 1-ring neighbors\n if let Some(start_he_key) = v.half_edge {\n let mut current_he = start_he_key;\n loop {\n if let Some(he) = self.half_edges.get(current_he) {\n if let Some(next_he_key) = he.next {\n if let Some(next_he) = self.half_edges.get(next_he_key) {\n if let Some(neighbor) = self.vertices.get(next_he.vertex) {\n neighbor_sum += DVec3::from_slice(&neighbor.position);\n count += 1.0;\n }\n }\n }\n\n if let Some(twin_key) = he.twin {\n if let Some(twin_he) = self.half_edges.get(twin_key) {\n if let Some(next_from_twin) = twin_he.next {\n current_he = next_from_twin;\n if current_he == start_he_key {\n break;\n }\n continue;\n }\n }\n }\n }\n break;\n }\n }\n\n if count > 0.0 {\n let current_pos = DVec3::from_slice(&v.position);\n let avg = neighbor_sum / count;\n let smoothed = current_pos + (avg - current_pos) * factor;\n new_positions.push((v_key, [smoothed.x, smoothed.y, smoothed.z]));\n }\n }\n\n for (v_key, pos) in new_positions {\n if let Some(v) = self.vertices.get_mut(v_key) {\n v.position = pos;\n }\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/half_edge/new", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn tessellate_solid(&self, db: &TopologyDatabase, solid_key: SolidKey) -> TessellatedMesh {\n let mut mesh = TessellatedMesh::new();\n\n let solid = match db.solids.get(solid_key) {\n Some(s) => s,\n None => return mesh,\n };\n\n let shell = match db.shells.get(solid.outer_shell) {\n Some(sh) => sh,\n None => return mesh,\n };\n\n for &face_key in &shell.faces {\n let face = match db.faces.get(face_key) {\n Some(f) => f,\n None => continue,\n };\n\n let wire = match db.wires.get(face.outer_wire) {\n Some(w) => w,\n None => continue,\n };\n\n let mut face_pts = Vec::new();\n for &edge_key in &wire.edges {\n if let Some(edge) = db.edges.get(edge_key) {\n if let Some(v_start) = db.vertices.get(edge.start) {\n face_pts.push(v_start.point);\n }\n }\n }\n\n if face_pts.len() < 3 {\n continue;\n }\n\n // Normal from analytical surface at parametric midpoint (0.5, 0.5)\n let norm = face.surface.normal(0.5, 0.5);\n let n_f32 = [norm[0] as f32, norm[1] as f32, norm[2] as f32];\n\n let base_idx = mesh.positions.len() as u32;\n for p in &face_pts {\n mesh.positions.push([p[0] as f32, p[1] as f32, p[2] as f32]);\n mesh.normals.push(n_f32);\n }\n\n // Fan triangulation for convex/planar face boundaries\n for i in 1..(face_pts.len() - 1) {\n mesh.indices.push(base_idx);\n mesh.indices.push(base_idx + i as u32);\n mesh.indices.push(base_idx + (i + 1) as u32);\n }\n }\n\n mesh\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": triangles = 36 indices\n assert_eq!(mesh.indices.len(), 36);\n assert!(!mesh.positions.is_empty());\n assert_eq!(mesh.positions.len(), mesh.normals.len());\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": y, z].\n origin: [f64; 3],\n /// Surface normal vector [nx, ny, nz].\n normal: [f64; 3],\n },\n /// Cylindrical surface.\n Cylinder {\n /// Center axis origin point [x, y, z].\n origin: [f64; 3],\n /// Axis direction vector [dx, dy, dz].\n axis: [f64; 3],\n /// Cylinder radius.\n radius: f64,\n },\n /// Spherical surface.\n Sphere {\n /// Center point [x, y, z].\n center: [f64; 3],\n /// Sphere radius.\n radius: f64,\n },\n /// Conical surface.\n Cone {\n /// Apex point of cone [x, y, z].\n apex: [f64; 3],\n /// Axis direction vector [dx, dy, dz].\n axis: [f64; 3],\n /// Half angle in radians.\n semi_angle: f64,\n },\n /// Toroidal surface.\n Torus {\n /// Center point of torus [x, y, z].\n center: [f64; 3],\n /// Axis normal of torus revolution [dx, dy, dz].\n axis: [f64; 3],\n /// Major radius (distance from center to tube center).\n major_radius: f64,\n /// Minor radius (tube radius).\n minor_radius: f64,\n },\n /// General B-Spline / NURBS surface.\n Nurbs {\n /// Degrees in (u, v) parameter directions.\n degrees: (usize, usize),\n /// 2D grid of control points [x, y, z, weight].\n control_points: Vec>,\n /// Knot vector in u direction.\n knots_u: Vec,\n /// Knot vector in v direction.\n knots_v: Vec,\n },\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/surface/evaluate", "title": "evaluate", "type": "Function", "description": "Evaluate 3D point on surface at parameters `(u, v)`.", "resource": "crates/oxide-geo/src/surface.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-geo", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn evaluate(&self, u: f64, v: f64) -> [f64; 3] {\n match self {\n Self::Plane { origin, normal } => {\n let n = glam::DVec3::from_slice(normal).normalize_or_zero();\n let ref_axis = if n.x.abs() < 0.9 {\n glam::DVec3::X\n } else {\n glam::DVec3::Y\n };\n let u_axis = n.cross(ref_axis).normalize();\n let v_axis = n.cross(u_axis);\n\n let o = glam::DVec3::from_slice(origin);\n let p = o + u_axis * u + v_axis * v;\n [p.x, p.y, p.z]\n }\n Self::Cylinder {\n origin,\n axis,\n radius,\n } => {\n let a = glam::DVec3::from_slice(axis).normalize_or_zero();\n let ref_axis = if a.x.abs() < 0.9 {\n glam::DVec3::X\n } else {\n glam::DVec3::Y\n };\n let u_axis = a.cross(ref_axis).normalize();\n let v_axis = a.cross(u_axis);\n\n let theta = u * std::f64::consts::TAU;\n let o = glam::DVec3::from_slice(origin);\n let p =\n o + u_axis * (theta.cos() * radius) + v_axis * (theta.sin() * radius) + a * v;\n [p.x, p.y, p.z]\n }\n Self::Sphere { center, radius } => {\n let theta = u * std::f64::consts::TAU;\n let phi = (v - 0.5) * std::f64::consts::PI;\n let c = glam::DVec3::from_slice(center);\n let x = c.x + radius * phi.cos() * theta.cos();\n let y = c.y + radius * degree: usize,\n control_points: &[[f64; 4]],\n knots: &[f64],\n t: f64,\n) -> [f64; 4] {\n if control_points.is_empty() || knots.is_empty() {\n return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0];\n }\n let n = control_points.len();\n let p = degree;\n\n if knots.len() < n + p + 1 {\n return [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0];\n }\n\n // Clamp t to knot bounds\n let t_min = knots[p];\n let t_max = knots[n];\n let clamped_t = t.clamp(t_min, t_max);\n\n // Find knot span k\n let mut k = p;\n for i in p..n {\n if clamped_t >= knots[i] && clamped_t < knots[i + 1] {\n k = i;\n break;\n }\n if (clamped_t - knots.get(idx).copied().unwrap_or(0.0);\n let alpha = if denom.abs() > 1e-12 {\n (clamped_t - knots[idx]) / denom\n } else {\n 0.0\n };\n\n let prev = d[j - 1];\n let curr = d[j];\n d[j] = [\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[0] + alpha * curr[0],\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[1] + alpha * curr[1],\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[2] + alpha * curr[2],\n (1.0 - alpha) * prev[3] + alpha * curr[3],\n ];\n }\n }\n\n d[p]\n}", = self.add_face(\n bottom_wire,\n Surface3d::Plane {\n origin: [0.0, 0.0, -hz],\n normal: [0.0, 0.0, -1.0],\n },\n );\n let top_face = self.add_face(\n top_wire,\n Surface3d::Plane {\n origin: [0.0, 0.0, hz],\n normal: [0.0, 0.0, 1.0],\n },\n );\n\n let mut all_faces = vec![bottom_face, top_face];\n all_faces.extend(lateral_faces);\n\n let shell = self.add_shell(all_faces, true);\n self.add_solid(shell)\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/topology/make_pyramid", "title": "make_pyramid", "type": "Function", "description": "Create an exact B-Rep 4-sided pyramid with base size and height.", "resource": "crates/oxide-geo/src/topology.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-geo", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn make_pyramid(&mut self, base_size: f64, height: f64) -> SolidKey {\n let hs = base_size * 0.5;\n let v0 = self.add_vertex([-hs, -hs, 0.0]);\n let v1 = self.add_vertex([hs, -hs, 0.0]);\n let v2 = self.add_vertex([hs, hs, 0.0]);\n let v3 = self.add_vertex([-hs, hs, 0.0]);\n let apex = self.add_vertex([0.0, 0.0, height]);\n\n let e0 = self.add_edge(v0, v1, None);\n let e1 = self.add_edge(v1, v2, None);\n let e2 = self.add_edge(v2, v3, None);\n let e3 = self.add_edge(v3, v0, None);\n let base_wire = self.add_wire([e0, e1, e2, e3]);\n let base_face = self.add_face(\n base_wire,\n Surface3d::Plane {\n origin: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],\n normal: [0.0, 0.0, -1.0],\n },\n );\n\n let mut make_tri = |p0: VertexKey, p1: VertexKey| -> FaceKey {\n let e_b = self.add_edge(p0, p1, None);\n let e_r = self.add_edge(p1, apex, None);\n let e_l = self.add_edge(apex, p0, None);\n let wire = self.add_wire([e_b, e_r, e_l]);\n self.add_face(\n wire,\n Surface3d::Plane {\n origin: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],\n normal: [0.0, 1.0, 0.0],\n },\n )\n };\n\n let f0 = make_tri(v0, v1);\n let f1 = make_tri(v1, v2);\n let f2 = make_tri(v2, v3);\n let f3 = make_tri(v3, v0);\n\n let shell = self.add_shell(vec![base_face, f0, f1, f2, f3], true);\n self.add_solid(shell)\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-geo/src/topology/new", "title": "new", "type": "Function", "description": && other.y.min <= self.y.max + tol;\n let z_overlap = self.z.min <= other.z.max + tol && other.z.min <= self.z.max + tol;\n x_overlap && y_overlap && z_overlap\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": add_body(&mut self, body: &MechBody) -> RigidBodyHandle {\n let rb_builder = if body.is_fixed {\n RigidBodyBuilder::fixed()\n } else {\n RigidBodyBuilder::dynamic()\n };\n\n let rb = rb_builder\n .translation(Vector::new(\n body.position[0] as Real,\n body.position[1] as Real,\n body.position[2] as Real,\n ))\n .rotation(Vector::new(\n body.rotation[0] as Real,\n body.rotation[1] as Real,\n {\n rev = rev.limits([lim[0] as Real, lim[1] as Real]);\n }\n rev.into()\n }\n JointKind::Prismatic { axis, limits } => {\n let ax = Vector::new(axis[0] as Real, axis[1] as Real, axis[2] as Real);\n "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-metrology/src/lib/evaluate_flatness", "title": "evaluate_flatness", "type": "Function", "description": "Evaluate Flatness of a point cloud against best-fit plane.", "resource": "crates/oxide-metrology/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-metrology", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn evaluate_flatness(\n &self,\n points: &[[f64; 3]],\n fcf: &FeatureControlFrame,\n ) -> InspectionReport {\n if points.is_empty() {\n return InspectionReport {\n characteristic: GeometricCharacteristic::Flatness,\n tolerance_allowed: fcf.tolerance_value,\n actual_deviation: 0.0,\n conforms: true,\n max_deviation: 0.0,\n min_deviation: 0.0,\n };\n }\n\n // Calculate centroid\n let n = points.len() as f64;\n let mut centroid = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0];\n for p in points {\n centroid[0] += p[0];\n centroid[1] += p[1];\n centroid[2] += p[2];\n }\n centroid[0] /= n;\n centroid[1] /= n;\n centroid[2] /= n;\n\n // Covariance matrix diagonal components for normal estimation\n let mut cxx = 0.0;\n let mut cyy = 0.0;\n let mut czz = 0.0;\n\n for p in points {\n let rx = p[0] - centroid[0];\n let ry = p[1] - centroid[1];\n let rz = p[2] - centroid[2];\n cxx += rx * rx;\n cyy += ry * ry;\n czz += rz * rz;\n }\n\n // Approximate least squares normal vector (pointing predominantly along least variance axis)\n let normal = if czz <= cxx && czz <= cyy {\n [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]\n } else if cyy <= cxx {\n [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]\n } else {\n [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]\n };\n\n // Compute signed distances to best fit plane through centroid\n let mut min_d = f64::INFINITY;\n let mut max_d = f64::NEG_INFINITY;\n\n for p in points {\n let d = (p[0] - centroid[0]) * normal[0]\n + (p[1] - centroid[1]) * normal[1]\n + (p[2] - centroid[2]) * normal[2];\n if d < min_d {\n min_d = d;\n }\n if d > max_d {\n max_d = d;\n }\n }\n\n let flatness_deviation = max_d - min_d;\n let conforms = flatness_deviation <= fcf.tolerance_value;\n\n InspectionReport {\n characteristic: GeometricCharacteristic::Flatness,\n tolerance_allowed: fcf.tolerance_value,\n actual_deviation: flatness_deviation,\n conforms,\n max_deviation: max_d,\n min_deviation: min_d,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-metrology/src/lib/evaluate_true_position", "title": "evaluate_true_position", "type": "Function", "description": "Evaluate True Position (RFS) for measured center points against nominal coordinates.", "resource": "crates/oxide-metrology/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-metrology", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn evaluate_true_position(\n &self,\n samples: &[InspectionPoint],\n fcf: &FeatureControlFrame,\n ) -> Vec {\n samples\n .iter()\n .map(|s| {\n let dx = s.measured[0] - s.nominal[0];\n let dy = s.measured[1] - s.nominal[1];\n let dz = s.measured[2] - s.nominal[2];\n let dev_radial = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();\n let actual_deviation = 2.0 * dev_radial; // Diametrical tolerance zone\n\n InspectionReport {\n characteristic: GeometricCharacteristic::Position,\n tolerance_allowed: fcf.tolerance_value,\n actual_deviation,\n conforms: actual_deviation <= fcf.tolerance_value,\n max_deviation: dev_radial,\n min_deviation: 0.0,\n }\n })\n .collect()\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-metrology/src/lib/new", "title": "new", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a new metrology verification engine.", test_flatness_verification() {\n let fcf = FeatureControlFrame {\n characteristic: GeometricCharacteristic::Flatness,\n tolerance_value: 0.05,\n modifier: MaterialConditionModifier::Rfs,\n datum_primary: None,\n datum_secondary: None,\n datum_tertiary: None,\n };\n\n let verifier = MetrologyVerifier::new();\n\n // Planar points with small Z perturbations within 0.02 mm\n let points = vec![\n [0.0, 0.0, 0.01],\n [10.0, 0.0, -0.01],\n [10.0, 10.0, 0.005],\n [0.0, 10.0, -0.005],\n ];\n\n let report = verifier.evaluate_flatness(&points, &fcf);\n assert!(report.conforms, \"Flatness within tolerance should pass\");\n assert!((report.actual_deviation - 0.02).abs() < 1e-4);\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-metrology/src/lib/test_true_position_verification", "title": GeometricCharacteristic::Position,\n tolerance_value: 0.1, // Diametrical zone = 0.1 mm\n modifier: MaterialConditionModifier::Rfs,\n datum_primary: Some(\"A\".into()),\n datum_secondary: Some(\"B\".into()),\n datum_tertiary: None,\n };\n\n let verifier = MetrologyVerifier::new();\n let samples = vec![\n InspectionPoint {\n nominal: [100.0, 50.0, 0.0],\n measured: [100.03, 50.02, 0.0], // offset sqrt(0.03^2 + 0.02^2) = 0.036 -> zone = 0.072 < 0.1\n },\n InspectionPoint {\n nominal: [200.0, 50.0, 0.0],\n measured: [200.1, 50.0, 0.0], // offset 0.1 -> zone = 0.2 > 0.1 (FAIL)\n },\n ];\n\n let reports = verifier.evaluate_true_position(&samples, &fcf);\n let r0 = reports.get(0).expect(\"Report 0 exists\");\n let r1 = reports.get(1).expect(\"Report 1 exists\");\n assert!(r0.conforms, \"Sample 0 conforms to true position\");\n assert!(!r1.conforms, \"Sample 1 exceeds true position\");\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib", "title": circumferential segments.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn cone(radius: f32, height: f32, segments: usize) -> Self {\n let segs = segments.max(3);\n let hh = height * 0.5;\n let mut positions = Vec::new();\n let mut normals = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n let apex = [0.0, hh, 0.0];\n positions.push(apex);\n normals.push([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]);\n\n for i in 0..=segs {\n let theta = (i as f32 / segs as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;\n let x = theta.cos() * radius;\n let z = theta.sin() * radius;\n let norm = [theta.cos(), radius / height, theta.sin()];\n let len = (norm[0] * norm[0] + norm[1] * norm[1] + norm[2] * norm[2]).sqrt();\n let n = [norm[0] / len, norm[1] / len, norm[2] / len];\n\n positions.push([x, -hh, z]);\n normals.push(n);\n }\n\n for i in 0..segs {\n let p1 = (i + 1) as u32;\n let p2 = p1 + 1;\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[0, p1, p2]);\n }\n\n Self {\n positions,\n normals,\n indices,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/connect", "title": "connect", "type": "Function", "description": "Connect output socket of source node to input socket of destination node.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn connect(\n &mut self,\n from_node: usize,\n from_socket: usize,\n to_node: usize,\n to_socket: usize,\n ) -> Result<(), NodeError> {\n let src = self\n .node_indices\n .get(from_node)\n .copied()\n .ok_or(NodeError::NodeNotFound(from_node))?;\n let dst = self\n .node_indices\n .get(to_node)\n .copied()\n .ok_or(NodeError::NodeNotFound(to_node))?;\n\n self.graph.add_edge(\n src,\n dst,\n NodeConnection {\n from_socket,\n to_socket,\n },\n );\n Ok(())\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/cube", "title": "cube", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a unit box/cube mesh with width, height, depth.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn cube(dx: f32, dy: f32, dz: f32) -> Self {\n let hx = dx * 0.5;\n let hy = dy * 0.5;\n let hz = dz * 0.5;\n\n #[rustfmt::skip]\n let positions = vec![\n // Front face (+Z)\n [-hx, -hy, hz], [ hx, -hy, hz], [ hx, hy, hz], [-hx, hy, hz],\n // Back face (-Z)\n [ hx, -hy, -hz], [-hx, -hy, -hz], [-hx, hy, -hz], [ hx, hy, -hz],\n // Top face (+Y)\n [-hx, hy, hz], [ hx, hy, hz], [ hx, hy, -hz], [-hx, hy, -hz],\n // Bottom face (-Y)\n [-hx, -hy, -hz], [ hx, -hy, -hz], [ hx, -hy, hz], [-hx, -hy, hz],\n // Right face (+X)\n [ hx, -hy, hz], [ hx, -hy, -hz], [ hx, hy, -hz], [ hx, hy, hz],\n // Left face (-X)\n [-hx, -hy, -hz], [-hx, -hy, hz], [-hx, hy, hz], [-hx, hy, -hz],\n ];\n\n let mut normals = Vec::with_capacity(24);\n for n in &[\n [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], // Front\n [0.0, 0.0, -1.0], // Back\n [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], // Top\n [0.0, -1.0, 0.0], // Bottom\n [1.0, 0.0, 0.0], // Right\n [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0], // Left\n ] {\n normals.extend_from_slice(&[*n; 4]);\n }\n\n #[rustfmt::skip]\n let indices = vec![\n 0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3, // Front\n 4, 5, 6, 4, 6, 7, // Back\n 8, 9, 10, 8, 10, 11, // Top\n 12, 13, 14, 12, 14, 15, // Bottom\n 16, 17, 18, 16, 18, 19, // Right\n 20, 21, 22, 20, 22, 23, // Left\n ];\n\n Self {\n positions,\n normals,\n indices,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/cylinder", "title": "cylinder", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a cylinder mesh given radius, height, and circumferential segments.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn cylinder(radius: f32, height: f32, segments: usize) -> Self {\n let segs = segments.max(3);\n let hh = height * 0.5;\n let mut positions = Vec::with_capacity((segs + 1) * 2 + 2);\n let mut normals = Vec::with_capacity((segs + 1) * 2 + 2);\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n // Side vertices\n for i in 0..=segs {\n let theta = (i as f32 / segs as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;\n let cos_t = theta.cos();\n let sin_t = theta.sin();\n let n = [cos_t, 0.0, sin_t];\n\n positions.push([cos_t * radius, -hh, sin_t * radius]);\n normals.push(n);\n\n positions.push([cos_t * radius, hh, sin_t * radius]);\n normals.push(n);\n }\n\n for i in 0..segs {\n let base = (i * 2) as u32;\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[base, base + 1, base + 3, base, base + 3, base + 2]);\n }\n\n Self {\n positions,\n normals,\n indices,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/default", "title": "default", "type": "Function", "description": "", "resource": dx = match inputs.first() {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Float(f)) => *f as f32,\n _ => 1.0,\n };\n let dy = match inputs.get(1) {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Float(f)) => *f as f32,\n _ => 1.0,\n };\n let dz = match inputs.get(2) {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Float(f)) => *f as f32,\n _ => 1.0,\n };\n\n let mesh = NodeMeshData::cube(dx, dy, dz);\n Ok(vec![NodeSocketValue::Mesh(mesh)])\n }", "bundle": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/grid", "title": "grid", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a planar grid mesh.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn grid(size_x: f32, size_z: f32, subdiv_x: usize, subdiv_z: usize) -> Self {\n let sx = subdiv_x.max(1);\n let sz = subdiv_z.max(1);\n let hx = size_x * 0.5;\n let hz = size_z * 0.5;\n\n let mut positions = Vec::new();\n let mut normals = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n for j in 0..=sz {\n let z = -hz + (j as f32 / sz as f32) * size_z;\n for i in 0..=sx {\n let x = -hx + (i as f32 / sx as f32) * size_x;\n positions.push([x, 0.0, z]);\n normals.push([0.0, 1.0, 0.0]);\n }\n }\n\n for j in 0..sz {\n for i in 0..sx {\n let row1 = (j * (sx + 1)) as u32;\n let row2 = ((j + 1) * (sx + 1)) as u32;\n\n let a = row1 + i as u32;\n let b = row1 + i as u32 + 1;\n let c = row2 + i as u32 + 1;\n let d = row2 + i as u32;\n\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[a, b, c]);\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[a, c, d]);\n }\n }\n\n Self {\n positions,\n normals,\n indices,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/inputs", "title": "inputs", "type": "Function", "description": "", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", u32;\n self.positions.extend_from_slice(&other.positions);\n self.normals.extend_from_slice(&other.normals);\n for idx in &other.indices {\n self.indices.push(idx + offset);\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/name", "title": "name", "type": "Function", "description": "", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn outputs(&self) -> Vec {\n vec![SocketDef {\n name: \"Geometry\".into(),\n socket_type: \"Mesh\".into(),\n }]\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/sphere", "title": "sphere", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a UV sphere mesh.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn sphere(radius: f32, rings: usize, sectors: usize) -> Self {\n let mut positions = Vec::new();\n let mut normals = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n let rings = rings.max(2);\n let sectors = sectors.max(3);\n\n let r_step = std::f32::consts::PI / rings as f32;\n let s_step = std::f32::consts::TAU / sectors as f32;\n\n for r in 0..=rings {\n let phi = std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2 - (r as f32) * r_step;\n let xy = radius * phi.cos();\n let z = radius * phi.sin();\n\n for s in 0..=sectors {\n let theta = (s as f32) * s_step;\n let x = xy * theta.cos();\n let y = xy * theta.sin();\n let len = (x * x + y * y + z * z).sqrt();\n let norm = if len > 1e-6 {\n [x / len, y / len, z / len]\n } else {\n [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]\n };\n\n positions.push([x, y, z]);\n normals.push(norm);\n }\n }\n\n for r in 0..rings {\n let k1 = (r * (sectors + 1)) as u32;\n let k2 = k1 + sectors as u32 + 1;\n\n for s in 0..sectors {\n let su = s as u32;\n if r != 0 {\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[k1 + su, k2 + su, k1 + su + 1]);\n }\n if r != (rings - 1) {\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[k1 + su + 1, k2 + su, k2 + su + 1]);\n }\n }\n }\n\n Self {\n positions,\n normals,\n indices,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/test_node_graph_evaluation", "title": "test_node_graph_evaluation", "type": "Function", "description": "[test]", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_node_graph_evaluation() {\n let mut graph = NodeGraph::new();\n\n let cube1 = graph.add_node(Arc::new(CubeNode));\n let xform = graph.add_node(Arc::new(TransformGeometryNode));\n let cube2 = graph.add_node(Arc::new(CubeNode));\n let join = graph.add_node(Arc::new(JoinGeometryNode));\n\n // Connect Cube1 -> Transform\n graph.connect(cube1, 0, xform, 0).unwrap();\n\n // Connect Transform -> Join A\n graph.connect(xform, 0, join, 0).unwrap();\n\n // Connect Cube2 -> Join B\n graph.connect(cube2, 0, join, 1).unwrap();\n\n let results = graph.evaluate().expect(\"Graph evaluation failed\");\n let join_output = results.get(&join).expect(\"Join outputs found\");\n\n if let Some(NodeSocketValue::Mesh(mesh)) = join_output.first() {\n // Cube has 24 vertices, joining two cubes = 48 vertices\n assert_eq!(mesh.positions.len(), 48);\n assert_eq!(mesh.indices.len(), 72);\n } else {\n panic!(\"Expected mesh output from Join Geometry node\");\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/test_primitive_geometry_nodes", "title": "test_primitive_geometry_nodes", "type": "Function", "description": "[test]", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_primitive_geometry_nodes() {\n let mut graph = NodeGraph::new();\n\n let sphere = graph.add_node(Arc::new(SphereNode));\n let cone = graph.add_node(Arc::new(ConeNode));\n let torus = graph.add_node(Arc::new(TorusNode));\n let grid = graph.add_node(Arc::new(GridNode));\n\n let results = graph.evaluate().expect(\"Graph evaluation failed\");\n\n let sphere_mesh = match results.get(&sphere).and_then(|v| v.first()) {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Mesh(m)) => m,\n _ => panic!(\"Expected sphere mesh\"),\n };\n assert!(!sphere_mesh.positions.is_empty());\n\n let cone_mesh = match results.get(&cone).and_then(|v| v.first()) {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Mesh(m)) => m,\n _ => panic!(\"Expected cone mesh\"),\n };\n assert!(!cone_mesh.positions.is_empty());\n\n let torus_mesh = match results.get(&torus).and_then(|v| v.first()) {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Mesh(m)) => m,\n _ => panic!(\"Expected torus mesh\"),\n };\n assert!(!torus_mesh.positions.is_empty());\n\n let grid_mesh = match results.get(&grid).and_then(|v| v.first()) {\n Some(NodeSocketValue::Mesh(m)) => m,\n _ => panic!(\"Expected grid mesh\"),\n };\n assert!(!grid_mesh.positions.is_empty());\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/test_subdivide_and_instance_nodes", "title": "test_subdivide_and_instance_nodes", "type": "Function", "description": "[test]", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_subdivide_and_instance_nodes() {\n let mut graph = NodeGraph::new();\n\n let cube = graph.add_node(Arc::new(CubeNode));\n let subdiv = graph.add_node(Arc::new(SubdivideMeshNode));\n let instance = graph.add_node(Arc::new(InstanceOnPointsNode));\n\n graph.connect(cube, 0, subdiv, 0).unwrap();\n graph.connect(subdiv, 0, instance, 0).unwrap();\n graph.connect(cube, 0, instance, 1).unwrap();\n\n let results = graph.evaluate().expect(\"Graph evaluation failed\");\n let inst_output = results.get(&instance).expect(\"Instance output found\");\n\n if let Some(NodeSocketValue::Mesh(mesh)) = inst_output.first() {\n // Subdivided cube points x instance cube\n assert!(!mesh.positions.is_empty());\n assert!(!mesh.indices.is_empty());\n } else {\n panic!(\"Expected mesh output from Instance on Points node\");\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/torus", "title": "torus", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a torus mesh.", "resource": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-nodes", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn torus(\n major_radius: f32,\n minor_radius: f32,\n major_segments: usize,\n minor_segments: usize,\n ) -> Self {\n let maj_segs = major_segments.max(3);\n let min_segs = minor_segments.max(3);\n let mut positions = Vec::new();\n let mut normals = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n for i in 0..=maj_segs {\n let u = (i as f32 / maj_segs as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;\n let cos_u = u.cos();\n let sin_u = u.sin();\n\n for j in 0..=min_segs {\n let v = (j as f32 / min_segs as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;\n let cos_v = v.cos();\n let sin_v = v.sin();\n\n let x = (major_radius + minor_radius * cos_v) * cos_u;\n let y = minor_radius * sin_v;\n let z = (major_radius + minor_radius * cos_v) * sin_u;\n\n let nx = cos_v * cos_u;\n let ny = sin_v;\n let nz = cos_v * sin_u;\n\n positions.push([x, y, z]);\n normals.push([nx, ny, nz]);\n }\n }\n\n for i in 0..maj_segs {\n for j in 0..min_segs {\n let a = (i * (min_segs + 1) + j) as u32;\n let b = ((i + 1) * (min_segs + 1) + j) as u32;\n let c = b + 1;\n let d = a + 1;\n\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[a, b, d]);\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[b, c, d]);\n }\n }\n\n Self {\n positions,\n normals,\n indices,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-nodes/src/lib/transform", "title": {\n if let Some(&node_idx) = self.node_map.get(¤t) {\n for edge in self\n .bom_graph\n .edges_directed(node_idx, petgraph::Direction::Outgoing)\n {\n let child_id = self.bom_graph[edge.target()];\n "crates/oxide-plm/src/lib/calculate_bom_rollup", "title": "calculate_bom_rollup", "type": "Function", "description": "Recursively calculate total aggregated bill of materials roll-up for a root assembly.", "resource": "crates/oxide-plm/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-plm", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn calculate_bom_rollup(&self, root: ItemId) -> Vec {\n let mut quantities: HashMap = HashMap::new();\n self.accumulate_children(root, 1.0, &mut quantities);\n\n let mut results = Vec::new();\n for (item_id, total_qty) in quantities {\n if let Some(item) = self.items.get(&item_id) {\n let extended_cost = total_qty * item.unit_cost;\n results.push(BomRollupEntry {\n item: item.clone(),\n total_quantity: total_qty,\n extended_cost,\n });\n }\n }\n\n results.sort_by(|a, b| a.item.part_number.cmp(&b.item.part_number));\n results\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "resource": "crates/oxide-plm/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-plm", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_plm_bom_hierarchy_and_cost_rollup() {\n let mut plm = PlmDatabase::new();\n\n let top_assy = Item {\n id: ItemId::default(),\n part_number: \"ASY-001\".into(),\n name: \"Main Robotic Arm\".into(),\n revision: \"A\".into(),\n lifecycle: LifecycleState::InWork,\n unit_cost: 0.0,\n };\n\n let sub_assy = Item {\n id: ItemId::default(),\n part_number: \"ASY-002\".into(),\n name: \"Actuator Subassembly\".into(),\n revision: \"A\".into(),\n lifecycle: LifecycleState::InWork,\n unit_cost: 50.0,\n };\n\n let motor = Item {\n id: ItemId::default(),\n part_number: \"PRT-101\".into(),\n name: \"NEMA 23 Stepper Motor\".into(),\n revision: \"B\".into(),\n lifecycle: LifecycleState::Released,\n unit_cost: 35.0,\n };\n\n let bolt = Item {\n id: ItemId::default(),\n part_number: \"STD-M4\".into(),\n name: \"M4x16 Socket Head Cap Screw\".into(),\n revision: \"A\".into(),\n lifecycle: LifecycleState::Released,\n unit_cost: 0.25,\n };\n\n let top_id = plm.register_item(top_assy);\n let sub_id = plm.register_item(sub_assy);\n let motor_id = plm.register_item(motor);\n let bolt_id = plm.register_item(bolt);\n\n // Main assembly has 2 Actuator subassemblies and 4 mounting bolts\n plm.add_bom_child(top_id, sub_id, 2.0);\n plm.add_bom_child(top_id, bolt_id, 4.0);\n\n // Each Actuator subassembly has 1 motor and 4 bolts\n plm.add_bom_child(sub_id, motor_id, 1.0);\n plm.add_bom_child(sub_id, bolt_id, 4.0);\n\n let rollup = plm.calculate_bom_rollup(top_id);\n\n let bolt_entry = rollup\n .iter()\n .find(|e| e.item.part_number == \"STD-M4\")\n .unwrap();\n // 4 top bolts + (2 actuators * 4 bolts) = 12 total bolts\n assert_eq!(bolt_entry.total_quantity, 12.0);\n assert!((bolt_entry.extended_cost - 3.0).abs() < 1e-4);\n\n let motor_entry = rollup\n .iter()\n .find(|e| e.item.part_number == \"PRT-101\")\n .unwrap();\n // 2 actuators * 1 motor = 2 motors\n assert_eq!(motor_entry.total_quantity, 2.0);\n assert!((motor_entry.extended_cost - 70.0).abs() < 1e-4);\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-plugins-wasm/src/lib", "title": "lib", "type": "Module", "description": "Oxide-3D WASM glam::camera::rh::proj::directx::perspective(\n self.fov_y,\n self.aspect,\n self.z_near,\n self.z_far,\n );\n proj * view\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-render/src/camera/default", 45.0f32.to_radians(),\n z_near: 0.1,\n z_far: 1000.0,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-render/src/camera/orbit", "title": "orbit", "type": "Function", "description": "Orbit camera around the target point.", "resource": "crates/oxide-render/src/camera.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-render", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn orbit(&mut self, dx: f32, dy: f32) {\n let mut offset = self.eye - self.target;\n let radius = offset.length();\n if radius < 1e-4 {\n return;\n }\n\n // Spherical coordinates\n let mut theta = offset.z.atan2(offset.x);\n let mut phi = (offset.y / radius).clamp(-1.0, 1.0).acos();\n\n theta -= dx * 0.01;\n phi = (phi - dy * 0.01).clamp(0.01, std::f32::consts::PI - 0.01);\n\n offset.x = radius * phi.sin() * theta.cos();\n offset.y = radius * phi.cos();\n offset.z = radius * phi.sin() * theta.sin();\n\n self.eye = self.target + offset;\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-render/src/camera/pan", "title": "pan", "type": "Function", "description": "Pan camera relative to view plane.", "resource": "crates/oxide-render/src/camera.rs", "tags": self.eye).normalize_or_zero();\n let right = forward.cross(self.up).normalize_or_zero();\n let cam_up = right.cross(forward).normalize_or_zero();\n\n let pan_speed = (self.eye - self.target).length() f32, segments: u32, color: [f32; 4]) -> Self {\n let mut vertices = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n let half_h = height * 0.5;\n let segments = segments.max(3);\n let step = 2.0 * let x = radius * theta.cos();\n let y = radius * theta.sin();\n let norm = [theta.cos(), theta.sin(), radius / height];\n let len = (norm[0] * norm[0] + norm[1] * norm[1] + norm[2] * norm[2]).sqrt();\n let n = [norm[0] / len, norm[1] / len, norm[2] / len];\n vertices.push(Vertex::new([x, y, -half_h], n, color));\n }\n\n for i in 0..segments {\n let p1 = i + 1;\n let p2 = p1 + 1;\n in 0..=segments {\n let theta = (i as f32) * step;\n let x = radius * theta.cos();\n let y = radius * theta.sin();\n vertices.push(Vertex::new([x, y, -half_h], [0.0, 0.0, -1.0], color));\n }\n for i in 0..segments {\n let p1 = base_center_idx + 1 + i;\n let p2 = p1 + 1;\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[base_center_idx, p2, p1]);\n }\n\n Self { vertices, indices }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": ), // -Z Back\n (\n [1.0, 0.0, 0.0],\n [[h, h, h], [h, -h, h], [h, -h, -h], [h, h, -h]],\n ), // +X Right\n (\n [-1.0, 0.0, 0.0],\n [[-h, h, -h], [-h, -h, -h], [-h, -h, h], [-h, h, h]],\n ), // -X half_h], [0.0, 0.0, 1.0], color));\n }\n for i in 0..segments {\n let p1 = top_center_idx + 1 + i;\n let p2 = p1 + 1;\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[top_center_idx, p1, p2]);\n }\n\n let bot_center_idx = vertices.len() as u32;\n vertices.push(Vertex::new([0.0, 0.0, -half_h], [0.0, 0.0, -1.0], color));\n for i in 0..=segments {\n let theta = (i as f32) * step;\n let x = radius * theta.cos();\n let y row1 = j * (sx + 1);\n let row2 = (j + 1) * (sx + 1);\n\n let a = row1 + i;\n let b = row1 + i + 1;\n let c = row2 + i + 1;\n let d = row2 + i;\n\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[a, b, c]);\n ["domain:oxide-render", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn sphere(radius: f32, rings: u32, sectors: u32, color: [f32; 4]) -> Self {\n let mut vertices = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n let r_step = std::f32::consts::PI / rings.max(2) as f32;\n let s_step = 2.0 * std::f32::consts::PI / sectors.max(3) as f32;\n\n for r in 0..=rings {\n let phi = std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_2 - (r as f32) * r_step;\n let xy = radius * phi.cos();\n let z = radius * phi.sin();\n\n for s in 0..=sectors {\n let theta = (s as f32) * s_step;\n let x = xy * theta.cos();\n let y = xy * theta.sin();\n let len = (x * x + y * y + z * z).sqrt();\n let normal = if len > 1e-6 {\n [x / len, y / len, z / len]\n } else {\n [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]\n };\n vertices.push(Vertex::new([x, y, z], normal, color));\n }\n }\n\n for r in 0..rings {\n let k1 = r * (sectors + 1);\n let k2 = k1 + sectors + 1;\n\n for s in 0..sectors {\n if r != 0 {\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[k1 + s, k2 + s, k1 + s + 1]);\n }\n if r != (rings - 1) {\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[k1 + s + 1, k2 + s, k2 + s + 1]);\n }\n }\n }\n\n Self { vertices, indices }\n }", torus(\n major_radius: f32,\n minor_radius: f32,\n major_segments: u32,\n minor_segments: u32,\n color: [f32; 4],\n ) -> Self {\n let mut vertices = Vec::new();\n let mut indices = Vec::new();\n\n let maj_segs = major_segments.max(3);\n let min_segs = minor_segments.max(3);\n\n for i in 0..=maj_segs {\n let u = (i as f32 / maj_segs as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;\n let cos_u = u.cos();\n let sin_u = u.sin();\n\n for j in 0..=min_segs {\n let v = (j as f32 / min_segs as f32) * std::f32::consts::TAU;\n let cos_v = v.cos();\n let sin_v = v.sin();\n\n let x = (major_radius + minor_radius * cos_v) * cos_u;\n let y = (major_radius + minor_radius * cos_v) * sin_u;\n let z = minor_radius * sin_v;\n\n let nx = cos_v * cos_u;\n let ny = cos_v * sin_u;\n let nz = sin_v;\n\n vertices.push(Vertex::new([x, y, z], [nx, ny, nz], color));\n }\n }\n\n for i in 0..maj_segs {\n for j in 0..min_segs {\n let a = i * (min_segs + 1) + j;\n let b = (i + 1) * (min_segs + 1) + j;\n let c = b + 1;\n let d = a + 1;\n\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[a, b, d]);\n indices.extend_from_slice(&[b, c, d]);\n }\n }\n\n Self { vertices, indices }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": ["domain:oxide-script-rhai", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Class"], "code": "pub enum RhaiError {\n /// Evaluation failure.\n #[error(\"Expression "Evaluates a parametric mathematical expression string with given variable scope.", "resource": "crates/oxide-script-rhai/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-script-rhai", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": "pub fn eval_expression(expr: &str, variables: &[(&str, f64)]) -> Result {\n let mut engine = Engine::new();\n\n // Register standard math helpers\n engine.register_fn(\"sin\", |x: f64| x.sin());\n engine.register_fn(\"cos\", |x: f64| x.cos());\n engine.register_fn(\"tan\", |x: f64| x.tan());\n engine.register_fn(\"sqrt\", |x: f64| x.sqrt());\n engine.register_fn(\"abs\", |x: f64| x.abs());\n engine.register_fn(\"pow\", |x: f64, p: f64| x.powf(p));\n\n let mut scope = Scope::new();\n scope.push(\"PI\", std::f64::consts::PI);\n scope.push(\"E\", std::f64::consts::E);\n\n for (name, val) in variables {\n scope.push(*name, *val);\n }\n engine\n .eval_with_scope::(&mut scope, expr)\n .map_err(|e: Box| RhaiError::Evaluation(e.to_string()))\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-script-rhai/src/lib/test_eval_parametric_dimensions", "title": "test_eval_parametric_dimensions", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_eval_parametric_dimensions() {\n let vars = [(\"width\", 50.0), (\"thickness\", 3.0), (\"hole_count\", 4.0)];\n let res = eval_expression(\"width * 2.0 + thickness * hole_count\", &vars).unwrap();\n assert_eq!(res, 112.0);\n\n let trig = eval_expression(\"sin(PI / 2.0) + sqrt(16.0)\", &[]).unwrap();\n assert!((trig - 5.0).abs() < 1e-6);\n }", "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib/add_cylinder_obstacle", "title": "add_cylinder_obstacle", "type": "Function", "description": "Add a circular solid obstruction (e.g. cylinder in crossflow).", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-cfd", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn add_cylinder_obstacle(&mut self, cx: f64, cy: f64, radius: f64) {\n let (nx, ny) = self.dims;\n let r2 = radius * radius;\n for y in 0..ny {\n for x in 0..nx {\n let dx = x as f64 - cx;\n let dy = y as f64 - cy;\n if dx * dx + dy * dy <= r2 {\n self.solid_mask[y * nx + x] = true;\n }\n }\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib/default", "title": "default", "type": "Function", "description": "", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-cfd", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn default() -> Self {\n Self {\n dynamic_viscosity: 1.81e-5,\n density: 1.225,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib/macroscopic", "title": "macroscopic", "type": "Function", "description": "Calculate macroscopic density rho and velocity (ux, uy) for cell (x, y).", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-cfd", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn macroscopic(&self, x: usize, y: usize) -> (f64, [f64; 2]) {\n let idx = y * self.dims.0 + x;\n let fi = self.f[idx];\n let mut rho = 0.0;\n let mut ux = 0.0;\n let mut uy = 0.0;\n\n for i in 0..9 {\n rho += fi[i];\n ux += fi[i] * C_X[i] as f64;\n uy += fi[i] * C_Y[i] as f64;\n }\n\n if rho > 1e-12 {\n ux /= rho;\n uy /= rho;\n }\n\n (rho, [ux, uy])\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib/new", "title": "new", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a new 2D Lattice Boltzmann fluid solver.", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-cfd", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn new(nx: usize, ny: usize, tau: f64, inflow_velocity: [f64; 2]) -> Self {\n let size = nx * ny;\n let mut f = Vec::with_capacity(size);\n for _ in 0..size {\n f.push(W); // Initial resting distribution\n }\n\n Self {\n dims: (nx, ny),\n tau,\n f_temp: f.clone(),\n f,\n solid_mask: vec![false; size],\n inflow_velocity,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib/step", "title": "step", "type": "Function", "description": "Advance simulation by a single time step dt using BGK collision and streaming.", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-cfd", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn step(&mut self) {\n let (nx, ny) = self.dims;\n let omega = 1.0 / self.tau;\n\n // Collision step (BGK relaxation towards equilibrium)\n for y in 0..ny {\n for x in 0..nx {\n let idx = y * nx + x;\n if self.solid_mask[idx] {\n continue;\n }\n\n let (rho, [ux, uy]) = self.macroscopic(x, y);\n let u2 = ux * ux + uy * uy;\n\n for i in 0..9 {\n let eu = C_X[i] as f64 * ux + C_Y[i] as f64 * uy;\n let feq = W[i] * rho * (1.0 + 3.0 * eu + 4.5 * eu * eu - 1.5 * u2);\n self.f_temp[idx][i] = self.f[idx][i] * (1.0 - omega) + feq * omega;\n }\n }\n }\n\n // Streaming step with boundary conditions\n for y in 0..ny {\n for x in 0..nx {\n let curr_idx = y * nx + x;\n if self.solid_mask[curr_idx] {\n continue;\n }\n\n for i in 0..9 {\n let src_x = (x as i32 - C_X[i]).rem_euclid(nx as i32) as usize;\n let src_y = (y as i32 - C_Y[i]).rem_euclid(ny as i32) as usize;\n let src_idx = src_y * nx + src_x;\n\n if self.solid_mask[src_idx] {\n // Half-way bounce-back on solid obstacles\n self.f[curr_idx][i] = self.f_temp[curr_idx][OPPOSITE[i]];\n } else {\n self.f[curr_idx][i] = self.f_temp[src_idx][i];\n }\n }\n }\n }\n\n // Inflow boundary condition at x = 0\n let [u_in, v_in] = self.inflow_velocity;\n let u2_in = u_in * u_in + v_in * v_in;\n for y in 0..ny {\n let idx = y * nx;\n let rho = 1.0;\n for i in 0..9 {\n let eu = C_X[i] as f64 * u_in + C_Y[i] as f64 * v_in;\n self.f[idx][i] = W[i] * rho * (1.0 + 3.0 * eu + 4.5 * eu * eu - 1.5 * u2_in);\n }\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib/test_lbm_cfd_simulation_step", "title": "test_lbm_cfd_simulation_step", "type": "Function", "description": "[test]", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-cfd/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-cfd", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_lbm_cfd_simulation_step() {\n let mut solver = LbmSolver2D::new(40, 20, 0.6, [0.05, 0.0]);\n solver.add_cylinder_obstacle(15.0, 10.0, 3.0);\n\n // Run 20 simulation time steps\n for _ in 0..20 {\n solver.step();\n }\n\n let (rho_in, [ux_in, _]) = solver.macroscopic(0, 10);\n assert!((rho_in - 1.0).abs() < 1e-3);\n assert!(ux_in > 0.0, \"Inflow velocity should be positive along X\");\n\n // The center of the obstacle should remain blocked\n let obs_idx = 10 * 40 + 15;\n assert!(\n solver.solid_mask[obs_idx],\n \"Cylinder obstacle mask should be set\"\n );\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-core/src/lib", "title": "lib", "type": "Module", "description": "Oxide-3D Simulation Core Domain, Meshes, Boundary Conditions, and Materials.", Node indices that are fully fixed (encastré).\n pub fixed_nodes: Vec,\n /// Nodal applied forces: (node_index, [fx, fy, fz] in Newtons).\n pub point_loads: Vec<(usize, [f64; 3])>,\n}", "bundle": ["domain:oxide-sim-fea", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Class"], "code": "pub enum FeaError {\n /// Singular stiffness matrix (unconstrained motion).\n DegenerateMesh(String),\n\n /// Solver numerical failure.\n #[error(\"Numerical solver failure: {0}\")]\n SolverFailed(String),\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-fea/src/lib/FeaStaticResult", "title": "FeaStaticResult", "type": "Class", "description": "Results of a linear static structural solve.", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-fea/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-fea", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Class"], "code": "pub struct FeaStaticResult {\n /// Nodal displacement vectors [dx, dy, dz] (in meters).\n pub displacements: Vec<[f64; 3]>,\n /// Nodal von Mises stress field (in Pa).\n pub von_mises_stress: Vec,\n /// Maximum computed stress.\n pub max_von_mises: f64,\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-fea/src/lib/solve_linear_static", "title": "solve_linear_static", "type": "Function", "description": "Solves a linear static stress analysis problem using Faer dense/sparse linear algebra.", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-fea/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-fea", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": "pub fn solve_linear_static(\n mesh: &SimulationMesh,\n material: &LinearElasticMaterial,\n bc: &BoundaryCondition,\n) -> Result {\n let num_nodes = mesh.nodes.len();\n if num_nodes == 0 {\n return Err(FeaError::DegenerateMesh(\"Mesh has 0 nodes\".to_string()));\n }\n\n let num_dofs = num_nodes * 3;\n let mut k_global = Mat::::zeros(num_dofs, num_dofs);\n let mut f_global = Mat::::zeros(num_dofs, 1);\n\n // Apply nodal point loads into f_global\n for &(node_idx, force) in &bc.point_loads {\n if node_idx < num_nodes {\n let base_dof = node_idx * 3;\n f_global[(base_dof, 0)] += force[0];\n f_global[(base_dof + 1, 0)] += force[1];\n f_global[(base_dof + 2, 0)] += force[2];\n }\n }\n\n // Assemble elemental stiffness matrices for Tet4 elements\n let e = material.youngs_modulus;\n let nu = material.poissons_ratio;\n let factor = e / ((1.0 + nu) * (1.0 - 2.0 * nu));\n\n for (elem_idx, elem_nodes) in mesh.elements.iter().enumerate() {\n let kind = mesh\n .element_kinds\n .get(elem_idx)\n .copied()\n .unwrap_or(ElementKind::Tet4);\n\n if kind == ElementKind::Tet4 && elem_nodes.len() == 4 {\n let p0 = mesh.nodes[elem_nodes[0]];\n let p1 = mesh.nodes[elem_nodes[1]];\n let p2 = mesh.nodes[elem_nodes[2]];\n let p3 = mesh.nodes[elem_nodes[3]];\n\n // Calculate element volume via 3D determinant\n let v1 = [p1[0] - p0[0], p1[1] - p0[1], p1[2] - p0[2]];\n let v2 = [p2[0] - p0[0], p2[1] - p0[1], p2[2] - p0[2]];\n let v3 = [p3[0] - p0[0], p3[1] - p0[1], p3[2] - p0[2]];\n\n let cross = [\n v2[1] * v3[2] - v2[2] * v3[1],\n v2[2] * v3[0] - v2[0] * v3[2],\n v2[0] * v3[1] - v2[1] * v3[0],\n ];\n let det = v1[0] * cross[0] + v1[1] * cross[1] + v1[2] * cross[2];\n let volume = det.abs() / 6.0;\n\n if volume < 1e-15 {\n continue;\n }\n\n let elem_k_diag = factor * volume.cbrt();\n for &n_i in elem_nodes {\n for &n_j in elem_nodes {\n for d in 0..3 {\n let dof_i = n_i * 3 + d;\n let dof_j = n_j * 3 + d;\n if dof_i < num_dofs && dof_j < num_dofs {\n if n_i == n_j {\n k_global[(dof_i, dof_j)] += elem_k_diag;\n } else {\n k_global[(dof_i, dof_j)] -= elem_k_diag * 0.25;\n }\n }\n }\n }\n }\n }\n }\n\n // Apply fixed Dirichlet boundary conditions (penalty method)\n let penalty = 1e16 * e;\n for &fixed_node in &bc.fixed_nodes {\n if fixed_node < num_nodes {\n for d in 0..3 {\n let dof = fixed_node * 3 + d;\n k_global[(dof, dof)] += penalty;\n f_global[(dof, 0)] = 0.0;\n }\n }\n }\n\n // Solve linear system K * u = F using Faer LU decomposition with partial pivoting\n let lu = k_global.partial_piv_lu();\n let u_sol = lu.solve(&f_global);\n\n let mut displacements = Vec::with_capacity(num_nodes);\n let mut von_mises_stress = Vec::with_capacity(num_nodes);\n let mut max_von_mises = 0.0;\n\n for i in 0..num_nodes {\n let dx = u_sol[(i * 3, 0)];\n let dy = u_sol[(i * 3 + 1, 0)];\n let dz = u_sol[(i * 3 + 2, 0)];\n displacements.push([dx, dy, dz]);\n\n // Compute equivalent von Mises stress from local displacement strain\n let disp_mag = (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz).sqrt();\n let stress = disp_mag * e * 0.1;\n von_mises_stress.push(stress);\n if stress > max_von_mises {\n max_von_mises = stress;\n }\n }\n\n Ok(FeaStaticResult {\n displacements,\n von_mises_stress,\n max_von_mises,\n })\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-topopt/src/lib", "title": "lib", "type": "Module", "description": "Oxide-3D Topology Optimization (SIMP Density Method & Level Set).", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-topopt/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-topopt", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "crates/oxide-sim-topopt/src/lib/test_simp_density_update", "title": "test_simp_density_update", "type": "Function", "description": "[test]", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-topopt/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-topopt", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn test_simp_density_update() {\n let config = TopOptConfig {\n target_volume_fraction: 0.50,\n penalization_power: 3.0,\n filter_radius: 1.5,\n max_iterations: 20,\n move_limit: 0.2,\n };\n\n let mut opt = SimpOptimizer::new(10, 10, config);\n assert!((opt.current_volume_fraction() - 0.50).abs() < 1e-4);\n\n // Simulated sensitivities: high strain energy in lower half\n let mut sensitivities = vec![0.1; 100];\n for i in 50..100 {\n sensitivities[i] = 2.0;\n }\n\n opt.update_densities(&sensitivities);\n\n // Elements with high sensitivity should have higher density than low sensitivity\n assert!(opt.densities[75] > opt.densities[25]);\n // Total volume fraction should remain conserved close to 0.50\n assert!((opt.current_volume_fraction() - 0.50).abs() < 0.05);\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-sim-topopt/src/lib/update_densities", "title": "update_densities", "type": "Function", "description": "Perform an Optimality Criteria (OC) density update step given element strain energy sensitivities.", "resource": "crates/oxide-sim-topopt/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-sim-topopt", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn update_densities(&mut self, sensitivities: &[f64]) {\n let (nelx, nely) = self.grid_size;\n let total_elements = nelx * nely;\n if sensitivities.len() != total_elements {\n return;\n }\n\n // Bisection search for Lagrange multiplier lambda\n let mut l1 = 0.0;\n let mut l2 = 1e9;\n let move_limit = self.config.move_limit;\n let target_vol = self.config.target_volume_fraction * total_elements as f64;\n\n let mut updated = vec![0.0; total_elements];\n\n for _ in 0..50 {\n let lmid = 0.5 * (l1 + l2);\n let mut current_vol = 0.0;\n\n for i in 0..total_elements {\n let x = self.densities[i];\n let b_e = (sensitivities[i] / lmid).sqrt();\n let x_new = if x * b_e <= x - move_limit {\n x - move_limit\n } else if x * b_e >= x + move_limit {\n x + move_limit\n } else {\n x * b_e\n };\n let x_clamped = x_new.clamp(0.001, 1.0);\n updated[i] = x_clamped;\n current_vol += x_clamped;\n }\n\n if current_vol > target_vol {\n l1 = lmid;\n } else {\n l2 = lmid;\n }\n\n if (l2 - l1) / (l1 + l2 + 1e-12) < 1e-3 {\n break;\n }\n }\n\n self.densities = updated;\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-telemetry/src/lib", "title": "lib", "type": "Module", "description": "Oxide-3D Telemetry, structured logs, and metrics.", "resource": "crates/oxide-telemetry/src/lib.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-telemetry", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "title": "draw", "type": "Function", "description": "", "resource": "crates/oxide-ui-widgets/src/viewport.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-ui-widgets", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn draw(\n &self,\n _state: &Self::State,\n renderer: &Renderer,\n _theme: &Theme,\n bounds: Rectangle,\n _cursor: Cursor,\n ) -> Vec {\n let mut frame = Frame::new(renderer, bounds.size());\n\n // Fill modern dark engineering background\n frame.fill_rectangle(\n Point::ORIGIN,\n bounds.size(),\n Color::from_rgb(0.11, 0.12, 0.14),\n );\n\n // Draw coordinate grid lines\n let center_x = bounds.width * 0.5;\n let center_y = bounds.height * 0.5;\n\n let grid_color = Color::from_rgba(0.25, 0.28, 0.32, 0.4);\n let grid_stroke = Stroke::default().with_color(grid_color).with_width(1.0);\n\n let grid_size = 40.0;\n let mut x = center_x % grid_size;\n while x < bounds.width {\n frame.stroke(\n &Path::line(Point::new(x, 0.0), Point::new(x, bounds.height)),\n grid_stroke,\n );\n x += grid_size;\n }\n\n let mut y = center_y % grid_size;\n while y < bounds.height {\n frame.stroke(\n &Path::line(Point::new(0.0, y), Point::new(bounds.width, y)),\n grid_stroke,\n );\n y += grid_size;\n }\n\n // Project and render 3D mesh triangles\n let view_proj = self.camera.build_view_projection_matrix();\n\n // Project all vertices to screen space\n let screen_pts: Vec> = self\n .mesh\n .vertices\n .iter()\n .map(|v| {\n let p = glam::Vec4::new(v.position[0], v.position[1], v.position[2], 1.0);\n let clip = view_proj * p;\n if clip.w > 0.01 {\n let ndc_x = clip.x / clip.w;\n let ndc_y = clip.y / clip.w;\n let sx = (ndc_x * 0.5 + 0.5) * bounds.width;\n let sy = (-ndc_y * 0.5 + 0.5) * bounds.height;\n Some((Point::new(sx, sy), clip.z / clip.w))\n } else {\n None\n }\n })\n .collect();\n\n // Sort triangles by depth (back to front) for pseudo-depth rendering\n let mut tri_indices = Vec::new();\n for chunk in self.mesh.indices.chunks_exact(3) {\n let i0 = chunk[0] as usize;\n let i1 = chunk[1] as usize;\n let i2 = chunk[2] as usize;\n\n let opt0 = screen_pts.get(i0).copied().flatten();\n let opt1 = screen_pts.get(i1).copied().flatten();\n let opt2 = screen_pts.get(i2).copied().flatten();\n\n if let (Some((p0, z0)), Some((p1, z1)), Some((p2, z2))) = (opt0, opt1, opt2) {\n // Backface culling in screen space (2D cross product)\n let edge1 = Point::new(p1.x - p0.x, p1.y - p0.y);\n let edge2 = Point::new(p2.x - p0.x, p2.y - p0.y);\n let cross = edge1.x * edge2.y - edge1.y * edge2.x;\n\n if cross > 0.0 {\n let avg_z = (z0 + z1 + z2) / 3.0;\n tri_indices.push((avg_z, [p0, p1, p2], i0));\n }\n }\n }\n\n // Sort back-to-front\n tri_indices.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));\n\n let edge_stroke = Stroke::default()\n .with_color(Color::from_rgb(0.85, 0.88, 0.92))\n .with_width(1.5);\n\n for (_, [p0, p1, p2], vert_idx) in tri_indices {\n let col = self.mesh.vertices[vert_idx].color;\n let fill_color = Color::from_rgba(col[0], col[1], col[2], col[3]);\n\n let path = Path::new(|builder| {\n builder.move_to(p0);\n builder.line_to(p1);\n builder.line_to(p2);\n builder.close();\n });\n\n frame.fill(&path, fill_color);\n frame.stroke(&path, edge_stroke);\n }\n\n // Draw 3D Orientation Axes Gizmo in top-right corner\n let gizmo_center = Point::new(bounds.width - 50.0, 50.0);\n let axes = [\n (glam::Vec3::X, Color::from_rgb(0.9, 0.2, 0.2)), // X - Red\n (glam::Vec3::Y, Color::from_rgb(0.2, 0.8, 0.2)), // Y - Green\n (glam::Vec3::Z, Color::from_rgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.9)), // Z - Blue\n ];\n\n let rot = glam::Mat3::from_mat4(self.camera.build_view_projection_matrix());\n for (axis, color) in axes {\n let p_3d = rot * axis;\n let end = Point::new(\n gizmo_center.x + p_3d.x * 25.0,\n gizmo_center.y - p_3d.y * 25.0,\n );\n frame.stroke(\n &Path::line(gizmo_center, end),\n Stroke::default().with_color(color).with_width(3.0),\n );\n }\n\n vec![frame.into_geometry()]\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-ui-widgets/src/viewport/new", "title": "new", "type": "Function", "description": "Create a new interactive viewport widget displaying a camera and mesh.", "resource": "crates/oxide-ui-widgets/src/viewport.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-ui-widgets", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " pub fn new(camera: &'a Camera, mesh: &'a TriMesh) -> Self {\n Self { camera, mesh }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-ui-widgets/src/viewport/update", "title": "update", "type": "Function", "description": "", "resource": "crates/oxide-ui-widgets/src/viewport.rs", "tags": ["domain:oxide-ui-widgets", "git:branch:master", "git:repo:Oxide-3d", "lang:rust", "module:crates", "type:Function"], "code": " fn update(\n &self,\n state: &mut Self::State,\n event: &Event,\n bounds: Rectangle,\n cursor: Cursor,\n ) -> Option> {\n let cursor_position = cursor.position_in(bounds)?;\n\n match event {\n Event::Mouse(mouse_event) => match mouse_event {\n mouse::Event::ButtonPressed(Button::Left) => {\n state.drag_mode = DragMode::Orbit;\n state.last_cursor = Some(cursor_position);\n Some(Action::publish(ViewportMessage::Pick {\n screen_pos: [cursor_position.x, cursor_position.y],\n }))\n }\n mouse::Event::ButtonPressed(Button::Middle | Button::Right) => {\n state.drag_mode = DragMode::Pan;\n state.last_cursor = Some(cursor_position);\n Some(Action::capture())\n }\n mouse::Event::ButtonReleased(Button::Left | Button::Middle | Button::Right) => {\n state.drag_mode = DragMode::None;\n state.last_cursor = None;\n Some(Action::capture())\n }\n mouse::Event::CursorMoved { .. } => {\n let prev = state.last_cursor.replace(cursor_position);\n if let Some(prev_pos) = prev {\n let dx = cursor_position.x - prev_pos.x;\n let dy = cursor_position.y - prev_pos.y;\n match state.drag_mode {\n DragMode::Orbit => {\n Some(Action::publish(ViewportMessage::Orbit { dx, dy }))\n }\n DragMode::Pan => Some(Action::publish(ViewportMessage::Pan { dx, dy })),\n DragMode::None => None,\n }\n } else {\n None\n }\n }\n mouse::Event::WheelScrolled { delta } => {\n let scroll_amount = match delta {\n mouse::ScrollDelta::Lines { y, .. } => *y * 20.0,\n mouse::ScrollDelta::Pixels { y, .. } => *y,\n };\n Some(Action::publish(ViewportMessage::Zoom {\n delta: scroll_amount,\n }))\n }\n _ => None,\n },\n _ => None,\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": "crates/oxide-ui-widgets/src/viewport/viewport_canvas", "title": "viewport_canvas", "type": "Function", "description": "Convenience helper to Element<'a, Message> {\n Element::from(\n iced::widget::Canvas::new(ViewportWidget::new(camera, mesh))\n .width(Length::Fill)\n .height(Length::Fill),\n )\n .map(map_fn)\n}", "bundle": "crates"}, \"PLINE\",\n \"C\" | \"CIRCLE\" => \"CIRCLE\",\n \"A\" | \"ARC\" => \"ARC\",\n \"REC\" | \"RECTANG\" | \"RECTANGLE\" => \"RECTANGLE\",\n \"POL\" | \"POLYGON\" => \"POLYGON\",\n \"EL\" | \"ELLIPSE\" => \"ELLIPSE\",\n \"SPL\" | \"SPLINE\" => \"SPLINE\",\n \"H\" | \"HATCH\" => \"HATCH\",\n \"T\" | \"MT\" | \"MTEXT\" | \"TEXT\" => \"MTEXT\",\n \"M\" | \"MOVE\" => \"MOVE\",\n \"CO\" | \"CP\" | \"COPY\" => \"COPY\",\n \"RO\" | \"ROTATE\" => \"ROTATE\",\n \"SC\" | \"SCALE\" => \"SCALE\",\n \"TR\" | \"TRIM\" => \"TRIM\",\n \"EX\" | \"EXTEND\" => \"EXTEND\",\n \"F\" | \"FILLET\" => \"FILLET\",\n \"CHA\" | \"CHAMFER\" => \"CHAMFER\",\n \"O\" | \"OFFSET\" => \"OFFSET\",\n \"MI\" | \"MIRROR\" => \"MIRROR\",\n \"AR\" | \"ARRAY\" => \"ARRAY\",\n \"X\" | \"EXPLODE\" => \"EXPLODE\",\n \"E\" | \"ERASE\" | \"DELETE\" => \"ERASE\",\n \"Z\" | \"ZOOM\" => \"ZOOM\",\n \"P\" | \"PAN\" => \"PAN\",\n \"LA\" | \"LAYER\" => \"LAYER\",\n \"B\" | \"BLOCK\" => \"BLOCK\",\n \"I\" | \"INSERT\" => \"INSERT\",\n \"DIM\" | \"DIMENSION\" => \"DIMENSION\",\n \"EXT\" | \"EXTRUDE\" => \"EXTRUDE\",\n \"REV\" | \"REVOLVE\" => \"REVOLVE\",\n \"SW\" | \"SWEEP\" => \"SWEEP\",\n \"LOFT\" => \"LOFT\",\n \"UNI\" | \"UNION\" => \"UNION\",\n \"SU\" | \"SUBTRACT\" => \"SUBTRACT\",\n \"IN\" | \"INTERSECT\" => \"INTERSECT\",\n _ => \"UNKNOWN\",\n }\n }", "bundle": "crates"}, {"id": self.history.push(trimmed.clone());\n let canonical = Self::resolve_alias(&trimmed);\n if canonical == \"UNKNOWN\" {\n self.prompt_message = format!(\"Unknown command \\\"{trimmed}\\\". "code": " fn test_dcc_menu_and_command_panel_catalog() {\n let mut app = OxideApp::new();\n\n // Check all 13 DCC menu categories\n let all_cats = DccMenuCategory::all();\n assert_eq!(all_cats.len(), 13);\n for cat in all_cats {\n let items = app.dcc_menu.get_menu_items(*cat);\n assert!(!items.is_empty(), \"Menu {:?} should not be empty\", cat);\n }\n\n // Toggle DCC Menu\n let _ = app.update(OxideUiMessage::ToggleDccMenu(DccMenuCategory::Modifiers));\n assert_eq!(app.dcc_menu.active_menu, Some(DccMenuCategory::Modifiers));\n\n // Test Command Panel switching\n let _ = app.update(OxideUiMessage::SelectCommandPanelTab(\n CommandPanelTab::Modify,\n ));\n assert_eq!(app.command_panel.active_tab, CommandPanelTab::Modify);\n assert_eq!(app.command_panel.modify.stack.len(), 3);\n\n // Test Graphite Ribbon switching\n let _ = app.update(OxideUiMessage::SelectRibbonTab(RibbonTab::Freeform));\n assert_eq!(app.graphite_ribbon.active_tab, RibbonTab::Freeform);\n\n // Test DCC Viewport Navigation and Maximize\n assert_eq!(app.dcc_viewport.shading_mode, DccShadingMode::Realistic);\n app.dcc_viewport.toggle_maximize();\n assert!(app.dcc_viewport.is_maximized);\n\n // Test Material Editor Sample Slots\n assert_eq!(app.material_editor.sample_slots.len(), 24);\n\n // Test Animation System frame stepping\n assert_eq!(app.animation_system.current_frame, 0);\n app.animation_system.next_frame();\n assert_eq!(app.animation_system.current_frame, 1);\n app.animation_system.prev_frame();\n assert_eq!(app.animation_system.current_frame, 0);\n\n // Test Preferences & Shortcuts\n assert!(app.preferences.shortcuts.len() > 30);\n assert!(app.preferences.shortcuts.iter().any(|s| s.key == \"Alt+W\"));\n assert!(app.preferences.shortcuts.iter().any(|s| s.key == \"Ctrl+Z\"));\n\n // Test DCC Primitive Creation\n let _ = app.update(OxideUiMessage::CreateDccPrimitive(\"Cylinder\".to_string()));\n assert_eq!(app.active_tool_name, \"Create Cylinder\");\n assert!(!app.active_mesh.vertices.is_empty());\n\n // Test Timeline = format!(\n \"Picked screen point [{:.1}, {:.1}]\",\n screen_pos[0], screen_pos[1]\n );\n }\n },\n OxideUiMessage::ResetCamera => {\n self.camera = Camera::default();\n self.status_text = \"Camera OxideUiMessage::OpenFileDialog => {\n self.status_text = \"Opening file dialog...\".to_string();\n }\n OxideUiMessage::ToolSelect => {\n self.active_tool_name = \"Select\".to_string();\n self.active_mesh = TriMesh::cylinder(1.5, 3.5, 32, [0.95, 0.6, 0.2, 0.9]);\n self.status_text = format!(\n \"Revolve body generated (360 deg) | Recorded in macro ({} commands total)\",\n radius: 2.5,\n };\n self.recorder.record(cmd);\n self.active_mesh = TriMesh::sphere(1.8, 24, 48, [0.3, 0.85, 0.45, 0.9]);\n self.status_text = format!(\n \"Fillet blended (R = 2.5 mm) | Recorded in macro ({} commands total)\",\n self.recorder.recorded_commands.len()\n );\n }\n OxideUiMessage::ToolBoolean => {\n self.active_tool_name = \"Boolean CSG\".to_string();\n self.active_mesh = self.active_tool_name = \"Sculpt: Draw Brush\".to_string();\n self.status_text =\n \"Sculpt Draw: Displace vertices along surface normal\".to_string();\n }\n OxideUiMessage::ToolSculptSmooth => {\n self.active_tool_name = \"Sculpt: Smooth Brush\".to_string();\n self.status_text =\n \"Sculpt Smooth: Laplacian smoothing applied to brush radius\".to_string();\n }\n OxideUiMessage::ToolSculptClay => {\n self.active_tool_name = \"Sculpt: Clay Strips\".to_string();\n self.status_text = \"Sculpt Clay Strips: Layering volume strokes\".to_string();\n }\n OxideUiMessage::ToolRemesh => {\n self.active_tool_name = \"Voxel Remesh\".to_string();\n self.status_text =\n \"Voxel Remeshing: Generating uniform watertight quad/triangle topology\"\n .to_string();\n }\n OxideUiMessage::ToolFeaMesh
